# Contributing to Terraform AWS Provider

Thank you for your interest in contributing to the **Terraform AWS Provider** maintained by [@VivekGitNinja](https://github.com/VivekGitNinja)!

We welcome all contributions from developers of all skill levels, including bug fixes, documentation improvements, new AWS resource additions, and code refactoring.

---

## 🚀 How to Get Started

### 1. Find an Issue
- Look for open issues labeled [`good first issue`](https://github.com/VivekGitNinja/Terraform-provider-aws/labels/good%20first%20issue) or [`help wanted`](https://github.com/VivekGitNinja/Terraform-provider-aws/labels/help%20wanted).
- Comment on the issue to let us know you'd like to work on it.

### 2. Set Up Your Environment
- **Fork** the repository to your GitHub account.
- **Clone** your fork locally:
  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/Terraform-provider-aws.git
  cd Terraform-provider-aws
  ```

### 3. Make Your Changes
- Create a new feature branch:
  ```bash
  git checkout -b feature/my-awesome-improvement
  ```
- Make your code or documentation changes.
- Ensure all tests pass:
  ```bash
  make build
  make test
  ```

### 4. Submit a Pull Request
- Push your branch to your fork:
  ```bash
  git push origin feature/my-awesome-improvement
  ```
- Open a **Pull Request** against the `main` branch of `VivekGitNinja/Terraform-provider-aws`.
- Provide a clear title and description explaining your change.

---

## 📜 Code & Documentation Guidelines

- **Go Standards**: Follow standard Go 1.26+ conventions and formatting (`gofmt`).
- **Commits**: Write clear, descriptive commit messages.
- **Community**: Be respectful and supportive to fellow contributors.

Thank you for building open-source together! 💙
